_comment: Continuous Workflow Orchestrator roadmap. Milestones run TOP-DOWN in priority order. The orchestrator picks the first milestone whose status is 'pending' or 'failed' (with retries remaining), drives Claude Code to implement its `goal`, then runs `verify` + build + production health before marking it 'done'. Edit freely; add new milestones to the end (or reorder).

milestones.title: Operations Command Center
milestones.goal: Live /ops dashboard of everything the OS is doing, with filters and per-mission execution timelines.

milestones.title: Weekly digest draft
milestones.goal: Once a week, the kernel prepares a Gmail DRAFT (never sends) summarizing the week's top priorities, completed missions, and open follow-ups. Must be idempotent (one digest draft per week, keyed by ISO week) and must not send email or create calendar events. Do not change the every-4h kernel cadence; add the weekly digest as an additional idempotent step in the kernel objective.

milestones.title: Installable PWA + offline shell
milestones.goal: Make Evolution OS installable on iPhone and Android as a PWA: valid manifest with icons, and a service worker that caches the app shell so it opens offline. Must not break any existing page, the voice interface, or the Command Center.

milestones.title: Mission quick-actions
milestones.goal: Add a small row of one-tap mission templates (e.g. 'Draft replies to unread leads', 'Weekly market update', 'Prep for tomorrow's meetings') on the /ops page that each start a mission via the existing /api/missions endpoint. Read-only elsewhere; do not change the mission engine.
